predictions.question: Do visitors in the hardware bay need an escort?

predictions.question: How far in advance must a paid time off request longer than 3 consecutive days be filed in Ripple HR?
predictions.answer: Full-time employees accrue 20 days of paid time off per calendar year. Requests longer than 3 consecutive days must be filed in Ripple HR at least 14 days before the first day off.
